name: SectionHeader
title: Templates/Platform/Page/SectionHeader
summary: The heading of one band inside a page: an h2 at the medium size with a one-line description, a copy-link affordance that appears when the heading is hovered or focused, and the band’s own actions on the right. A billing page renders one above each of its cards and tables, and a resource’s Get started block opens with one (that one is its own GetStarted template). Built from `CopyButton` and `Button`; below `md` the actions drop under the copy and the row wraps.

variants.name: WithActions
variants.summary: The Billing payment-methods heading, with the outlined Add payment method action and its plus glyph on the right.
